newsitem.title: GERMANY: German industry praises Buba's two-year M3 goal.
newsitem.headline: German industry praises Buba's two-year M3 goal.

text.p: Germany's Chamber of Industry and Commerce (DIHT) on Thursday praised the Bundesbank's decision to set a two-year target for money supply growth to cover the difficult runup to European monetary union.
"Today's decision by the Bundesbank offers the chance to balance out short-term overshoots in money supply growth over the medium term," the DIHT said in a statement.

The DIHT said likely turbulence on foreign exchange markets would make meeting money supply targets more difficult than usual. "But that should not give rise to doubts over stability-oriented policies," it added.

The Bundesbank earlier said it would tighten its M3 money supply growth target to between 3.5 percent and 6.5 percent over the next two years from 4-7 percent this year. It added that annual growth of five percent would be appropriate.
